broadSolidResults.title: Dev diagnostics: attribution cost checks (WIDE_SCOPE_DEPS at 30) now on by default via performance tracks, and count HMR plumbing
createOptimisticStore overlay is not reverted after a failed action while attribution is enabled (rc.10 regression)
Observe: open one interaction frame per event, so listeners outside the runtime can join it
2.0.0-rc.11 (diagnostics): WASTED_RECOMPUTE reports every createProjection re-run as unchanged, including runs that changed the store
Cannot use istanbul ignore comments for generated code
[2.0.0-rc.13] GRAPH_GROWTH treats the pre-content initial route declaration as a completed visit
Expose diagnostic names for renderer-owned effects in @solidjs/universal
2.0.0-rc.1 | flush cost scales with total materialized store signals (async-companion walk in sync-only apps)
Projection/derived-store recomputes are lane-captured by unrelated in-flight transitions (committed rail serves torn state)
2.0.0-beta.16: streaming SSR — a root-level `lazy()` after a pending `<Loading>` renders HTML but never hydrates
isPending(source) drops while a server component's streamed content is still in flight — frame fill is not attributed to the source transition
SSR streaming: async head-tag props (`<Title>{asyncValue()}</Title>` in `<Loading>`) never suspend the boundary and are dropped with a NotReadyError warning
Perf tracker: Solid primitives vs the hand-rolled `@yak/solid` runtime
Bundle size audit: pay-for-use tree-shaking for @solidjs/signals subsystems
Streamed <Loading> boundary silently dies when the trailing `_fr` resolution chunk is lost (host truncates stream) — plus `_$HY.fe` is never implemented
2.0.0-rc.7: mounting N rows is O(N²) when each row creates an effect over a signal written during its own creation — markHeap re-walks the whole pure heap on every memo pull
